pk.context: 10 mg oral, single dose, healthy adults

tell: A leukotriene receptor antagonist whose boxed warning covers serious neuropsychiatric events.

clues.text: Oral bioavailability is 64%, and a standard morning meal does not change it. Over 99% is bound to plasma proteins, and the drug leaves almost entirely through bile.
A monosodium salt that is a hygroscopic powder, freely soluble in water; the active moiety has a molecular weight of 586.2.
Approved under an NDA as 10 mg tablets, 4 and 5 mg chewable tablets and 4 mg oral granules, dosed once daily.
Boxed warning for serious neuropsychiatric events; contraindicated in hypersensitivity to any component. Upper respiratory infection and headache are the most common reactions.
Prophylaxis and chronic treatment of asthma, prevention of exercise-induced bronchoconstriction, and relief of allergic rhinitis symptoms.
Binds the CysLT1 receptor with high affinity and selectivity, blocking LTD4 actions there without any agonist activity.
The generic name begins with M and has eleven letters.
